reported_propositions.proposition: A legal-adviser summary identifies DP 3205/2014 before Juzgado de Instrucción nº 1 de Arrecife.

The summary attributes a complaint to two persons described as Community president and administrator; the source forms are only candidate bridges to the existing Asunción Aizpurúa Sánchez and Francisco Mario Matos Matas records.
The summary says the complaint was directed against Gil Marer and a second reported respondent concerning a historical falta de lesiones.
The author stated that no further information was held.

allegations_context.reasonable_alternative: An ordinary personal complaint after a reported altercation, with Community titles used descriptively rather than as proof of institutional action, remains a live non-culpable explanation.
